mapper.insert: INSERT INTO torrent_native_parse_result (job_uuid, user_id, info_hash, display_name, total_bytes, files_json, verified_torrent_bytes, created_at, deleted) VALUES (#{record.jobUuid}, #{record.userId}, #{record.infoHash}, #{record.displayName}, #{record.totalBytes}, #{record.filesJson}, #{record.verifiedTorrentBytes,jdbcType=BLOB}, #{record.createdAt}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, job_uuid, user_id, info_hash, display_name, total_bytes, files_json, verified_torrent_bytes, created_at, deleted FROM torrent_native_parse_result WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND job_uuid = #{jobUuid} AND deleted = 0
